## 检查 / How it was checked

-

独立审查不是必需的。日常小改动也可以不打开 Pull Request。
An independent reviewer is optional. Small solo changes do not need a pull request.

维护者通常用简体中文撰写 PR 说明。英文摘要可按读者需要添加。外部贡献者可使用英文或简体中文，英文摘要可选。全文翻译为可选。
Maintainers generally write PR descriptions in Simplified Chinese and can add a brief English summary when it helps readers. External contributors can use English or Simplified Chinese, with an optional English summary. Full translations are optional.
